title: Compliance
description: Operational posture for auditors: retention, keys, backups, TLS, identity, plugin trust and high availability, measured on this instance.

audit.title: Audit retention and forwarding
audit.description: How long the audit trail is kept and whether it leaves the box.

keys.title: Encryption keys
keys.description: Where the at-rest encryption key comes from and whether backups are encrypted.

instanceBackup.title: Instance backup
instanceBackup.description: Schedules and the last successful export of McHarbor itself.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: The certificate this node serves and when it expires.

passwords.title: Password policy
passwords.description: Rules every local password must meet.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: Share of active local accounts with MFA enrolled. Accounts from an identity provider use that provider's MFA.

identitySync.title: Identity and provisioning
identitySync.description: Enabled identity providers and SCIM provisioning health.

plugins.title: Plugin signing
plugins.description: Installed plugins without a valid signature from a trusted key.

ha.title: High availability
ha.description: Deployment mode and this node's readiness.

selfEnvAccess.title: Container access to McHarbor's host
selfEnvAccess.description: Roles holding containers.manage on the environment McHarbor itself runs on. There it reaches McHarbor's keys and database through a container that mounts the Docker socket or the host, so it is admin-equivalent unless the role also holds host_self.manage.

supplyChain.title: SBOM and image signing
supplyChain.description: Release images carry an SPDX SBOM and are signed with cosign keyless signing. Verify them with the commands in Getting started → Verifying releases.

reasons.sourceUnavailable: The data behind this section could not be read. The server log names the cause.
reasons.retentionShort: Audit rows are deleted after less than a year.
reasons.noForwarding: No audit log forwarder is enabled, so the trail exists only on this instance.
reasons.encryptionKeyGenerated: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set; the key was generated into the data directory and is lost with it.
reasons.encryptionKeyGeneratedShared: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set on a shared database; every node must use the same key.
reasons.noBackupKey: No backup encryption key is configured.
reasons.noBackupSchedule: No instance backup schedule is enabled.
reasons.noSuccessfulBackup: No instance backup has ever completed.
reasons.backupStale: The last successful instance backup is more than seven days old.
reasons.lastBackupFailed: The most recent instance backup failed.
reasons.verifyFailed: The most recent backup verification failed.
reasons.tlsDisabled: TLS is off on this listener. That is only acceptable behind a TLS-terminating proxy on a private network.
reasons.certUnreadable: The served certificate could not be read.
reasons.certExpiringSoon: The served certificate expires within 30 days.
reasons.minLengthTooShort: The minimum password length is below 8 characters.
reasons.minLengthShort: The minimum password length is below 12 characters.
reasons.noLocalUsers: There are no active local accounts.
reasons.mfaNone: No active local account has MFA enrolled.
reasons.mfaPartial: Some active local accounts have no MFA enrolled.
reasons.noIdentityProvider: No identity provider or SCIM endpoint is enabled.
reasons.scimSyncFailing: At least one SCIM endpoint's last sync failed.
reasons.unsignedPlugins: Some installed plugins were accepted without a valid signature.
reasons.pluginStoreLocal: Active/passive with a local plugin store: a promoted node may be missing plugin packages.
reasons.releaseArtifacts: Published with every release; not measured on this instance.
reasons.selfEnvironmentNotFound: No environment could be matched to the Docker daemon McHarbor runs on, so no role is flagged.
reasons.containersManageIsAdmin: A role holds containers.manage on the environment McHarbor runs on without host_self.manage. On that environment it can start a container that mounts the Docker socket or the host and read McHarbor's keys and database, which makes it admin-equivalent. Grant it on other environments only, or treat the role as an administrator role.
reasons.containersManageOverrideIsAdmin: A user holds a direct containers.manage grant on the environment McHarbor runs on without host_self.manage. A role review does not show this grant, yet it reaches McHarbor's keys and database the same way. Remove the override, scope it to another environment, or grant host_self.manage deliberately.

report.title: Download compliance report
report.description: Choose the sections, the format and whether to redact identifying values.
report.redactHint: Replaces key IDs, node IDs and certificate subjects with [redacted]. Secrets are never included either way.
report.previewNone: Nothing in the selected sections is redacted.
report.failed: The report could not be generated.
